thread:
Priya N: quick brain-dump from the design huddle: proposal for a Probabilistic Hedge Controller (PHC). intent: reduce cold-cache/mirroring cost while still protecting latency-sensitive tenants. sharing draft policy & questions.

Priya N: policy sketch (pseudo-json): ```json
{
  "route": "/complete",
  "policy": "probabilistic_hedge",
  "seed_window_s": 60,
  "initial_hedge_p": 0.05,
  "max_hedge_p": 0.5,
  "backoff_on_stability": 0.5,
  "min_samples": 100,
  "tenant_health_metric": "tenant_health_score"
}
```

Sam K: this looks promising. question: how compute tenant_health_score? naive = weighted sum(error_rate, tail_latency, recent_rollbacks). we should normalize per-tenant baseline to avoid noisy small-tenants triggering hedges.

Alex G: agree. define baseline by a rolling baseline percentile over last 24h. score = (err_pct / baseline_err_pct) * w1 + (p99 / baseline_p99) * w2. thresholding then maps to hedge_p.

Maria L: telemetry note: we need to emit hedge_decision={rolled,hedged,skipped} and hedge_reason tags. also hedge_sample_rate for traced requests. ops can't debug a hedge if they only see counts.

Priya N: ops UX idea: Console shows per-tenant "hedge heat" timeline with events: seed-phase, ramp, stabilization, cooled. plus links to sampled traces.

Sam K: tradeoffs: probabilistic hedging reduces double-cost compared to deterministic mirror, but makes debugging inconsistent results across requests. we should allow deterministic-mirror mode for narrow windows or for tenants who opt-in (e.g., enterprise).

Alex G: also need cache-warmup hints. when hedging triggers for a prefix often, emit a control-plane hint to prewarm backup cache for that prefix (async). this avoids full mirroring while still warming.

Maria L: safety rules: (1) never hedge if tenant quota low or if variant capacity strained, (2) min_samples guard before increasing hedge_p, (3) emergency hard-swap if error_rate > 20% and p95 latency > X for 3 windows.

Priya N: anti-flap: hysteresis window of 15m after a change where hedge_p cannot increase > previous_p * 2. also a cooldown before auto-clear of emergency swap (30m).

Sam K: instrumentation: metrics -> phc_hedge_attempt_total, phc_hedge_success_total (i.e., backup returned faster/better), phc_hedge_cost_estimate_tokens, phc_tenant_health_score. traces: tag request with hedge=true/false and include decision_fields.

Alex G: testing plan: sim harness with mixed-tenancy load, synthetic cache cold prefixes, and a noisy small-tenant scenario to confirm min_samples works. also a deterministic mode for e2e tests so results are reproducible.

Maria L: policy rollout: start as read-only telemetry for 2 weeks, then seed-mode (probabilistic but no routing change, just sample), then active hedging with low initial p. ops feature flag per-tenant.

Priya N: implementation notes: PHC lives in runtime decision layer. must be cheap: avoid heavy evals. compute tenant_health_score in aggregator service and stream to routers via compact gRPC channel.

Sam K: perf note: gRPC fanout for thousands of tenants -> use sparse updates, only push deltas when score crosses bucket boundary.

Alex G: one more: add an "explain" header on sampled responses that includes decision_bucket and baseline_used. helps SRE triage.

ops-bot: :white_check_mark: RFC PR created: "probabilistic-hedge-controller: initial draft" (https://git.internal/r/4189)

Priya N: next steps: I'll PR the policy proto and a small sim harness. Sam - can you produce the normalization formula? Maria - will draft the telemetry dashboard mock. Alex - can you vet the runtime placement?

Sam K: will do the formula draft by EOD.

Maria L: mockups in 2 days.

Alex G: I'll scope the runtime change and post a plan. thanks all. :raised_hands:
